current.text: Fox is expected to start for the Spurs. The team is leaning toward a three-guard lineup of Fox, Dylan Harper and Stephon Castle, and it started three guards in the preseason.
It is not clear whether all three guards will get starter minutes. One expert says he has no idea what Fox's role will be.
Castle starts many possessions with the ball, and Fox often plays off the ball as a secondary weapon.
Experts expect him to lose on-ball time to Harper. They doubt he improves on last season or repeats 19 points, 4 rebounds and 6 assists.
With two other point guards next to him, his assists are unlikely to go up.
The Spurs are deep, and their players had low minutes last season. Minutes may stay low after the long playoff run.
He came back about 10 days after a high ankle sprain in the Minnesota playoff series. He was clearly not himself and had lost his downhill burst.
He should be healthier this season. A healthy Fox is described as the key ceiling raiser for the Spurs.
Josh ranks him 70 to 90 in category leagues. Fox is his best Spurs target if he falls to the 90s. Do not take him around pick 50 or earlier, because that price assumes a big bounce back.

Experts disagree on his price around picks 70 to 95. Some say 70 is too high and would not draft him there. Others say the hate has gone too far, that pick 95 is way too late, and that he still starts with solid minutes.
The Spurs are projected to be a top team in the West. One host predicts 63 wins.
The Spurs play 3, 4 and 3 games in our fantasy playoff weeks. They have only 13 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: His steals and free throw percentage swing a lot from year to year, which makes them hard to trust.
Experts do not see him as a high-assist lead guard.
Injury history: hamstring problems in 2025-26 and a serious high ankle sprain in the 2026 playoffs.

note: Our league paid 21 USD for him last season, but Yahoo values him at 16 USD and ESPN at 10 USD, and the experts rank him 70 to 90 in categories. A price around 10 to 14 USD fits that range. With no weak category flagged and his best output in assists (5.6) and steals (1.4), he fits any build. Early in the season, check whether the three-guard lineup holds, whether his minutes stay near 31, and whether his downhill burst is back after the ankle sprain.
